newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai July sugar exports fall from year ago.
newsitem.headline: Thai July sugar exports fall from year ago.

text.p: Thai sugar exports fell to 325,164 tonnes in July from 485,311 tonnes in June and 366,919 tonnes a year ago, trade sources said on Friday.
They said the July exports were 152,047 tonnes of raw sugar and 173,117 tonnes of refined white sugar.
Major buyers of Thai raw sugar in July were Japan (93,350 tonnes), South Korea (42,752 tonnes), Malaysia (7,300), and Sri Lanka (6,000).
Major buyers of refined white sugar in July were Iran (151,000 tonnes), Syria (14,000 tonnes), Brunei (3,000 tonnes), Cambodia (2,600 tonnes), and Sri Lanka (1,550 tonnes).

Thailand exported about 4.09 million tonnes of sugar during January/July, up from 3.22 million a year ago. Exports during the first seven months of 1996 were 2.74 million tonnes of raw sugar and 1.34 million tonnes of refined white and brown sugar.

Japan topped Thailand's buyers list during January/July, with 644,334 tonnes of raw and white sugar, Indonesia (636,800 tonnes), South Korea (578,468 tonnes), China (448,743 tonnes), Malaysia (367,100 tonnes), the Philippines (316,032 tonnes), Iran (305,000 tonnes), United Arab Emirates (99,523 tonnes), Tanzania (56,400 tonnes) and Romania (25,000 tonnes).
